note: Quiet Corps of Engineers campground 5 mi west of Hot Springs in the southern Black Hills, about a mile's drive from small Cottonwood Springs Lake (steep ramp, no gas motors; bass, trout, panfish). Non-electric sites with drinking water, flush toilets, a playground and a camp host; a gravel path runs through the wildlife area, where pets may go off-leash. Every site is booked on recreation.gov, same-day included. --Claude
